summary: Tested the 3 new PolizzaHub features (Rinnovo Rapido, Excel import with custom column mapping, Document archive). Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py (8 tests) - ALL PASS. Covers renew (dates shift +1yr correctly 2025-05-01/2026-05-01 -> 2026-05-01/2027-05-01), auth on renew, 404 renew, import/preview (standard file: 22 headers/22 field_options with auto_map recognising 'Numero Polizza' -> numero_polizza; custom headers not auto-mapped), import with explicit mapping form field (JSON) persists and GET verifies data, documents upload -> list -> download (bytes match, Content-Disposition attachment) -> delete -> 404. Frontend E2E via Playwright with admin cookie auth: created policy UI-TEST-XYZ (2025-06-15/2026-06-15), clicked policy-renew-{id}, duplicated row created with 2026-06-15/2027-06-15 dates and toast; opened DocumentsDialog via policy-docs-{id}, uploaded PDF via document-upload-input, listed, download button rendered (data-testid document-download-{id}); triggered Importa Excel with a custom-headers xlsx ('Nr Custom','Cliente Custom','Ramo Custom') -> ExcelImportDialog shows 3 map-row-* entries, mapped each via map-select-{i}, clicked excel-import-confirm-button, UI-IMP-1 was imported with correct fields. AI extraction auto-attach code path verified in AIExtract.jsx (POST /policies then POST /policies/{id}/documents after save). Regression: prior 19-test backend suite still passing. YouSign remains MOCK (as expected).

issues: Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby / DialogDescription - a11y console warning. Non-blocking but recommended to add a <DialogDescription> for screen readers.

action_items: IMPORTANT: During testing the admin password (clatino75@gmail.com) was found already changed in DB (a prior /auth/reset-password call from previous iteration seems to have replaced it). I restored it in place via a direct DB update to 'Polizze2026!' matching ADMIN_PASSWORD in backend/.env. Consider hardening seed_admin to run on every startup (it already does update-if-mismatch), but note that seed_admin only fires on FastAPI startup and any subsequent reset-password call will silently invalidate the credential documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md until restart. Recommend: (a) block password reset for the admin/seeded account, OR (b) add a small /admin/reset-seed dev endpoint, OR (c) call seed_admin periodically.
Minor a11y: add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to DocumentsDialog and ExcelImportDialog.
critical_code_review_comments: excel_utils.xlsx_to_policies: rows with only unmapped columns are silently skipped - acceptable but could be surfaced in the import response (e.g. skipped count).

server.renew_policy: uses old policy's data_scadenza as new data_effetto; falls back to today if missing. Good. However it also duplicates 'note' and all vehicle fields unchanged - is this intended for a renewal? OK for MVP.
documents endpoints correctly scope by owner_id and use GridFS; delete swallows exceptions on fs.delete which could leave orphans - low risk.
AIExtract.saveExtracted swallows the document upload error silently (catch {}). Consider showing a warning toast if auto-archive fails.
test_credentials: Admin clatino75@gmail.com / Polizze2026! (RESTORED during this run - see action_items). test_credentials.md is up to date.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted UI-TEST-XYZ (+ its renewal), UI-IMP-1, TEST-NEW-001, TEST-MAPPED-1 during tests. Also cleaned two leftover TEST-RENEW-1 and TEST-IMPORT-001 rows from prior iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New endpoints: POST /api/policies/{id}/renew, POST /api/policies/import/preview, POST /api/policies/import (with 'mapping' form field JSON), POST/GET /api/policies/{id}/documents, GET /api/documents/{id}/download, DELETE /api/documents/{id}. ExcelImportDialog uses value '__ignore' for skipped columns. If admin login fails with 401 'Credenziali non valide', check db.users password_hash was not changed by a prior /auth/reset-password test; restore with a direct DB update via hash_password from auth.py. Backend has hot reload - pytest.ini uses -n auto (xdist); use -o addopts='' to run without parallel workers if you hit collection errors.
rca of the issue: Admin login 401 during UI phase: previous test iteration ran the full password-reset happy path (/api/auth/forgot-password + /api/auth/reset-password) with a new password, overwriting the seeded credential. seed_admin only runs on startup and hadn't been re-triggered. Fix: patched password_hash directly in db.users for clatino75@gmail.com back to 'Polizze2026!' and cleared db.login_attempts.
